## About Me

I am an Applied Statistics and Biology student at the University of Virginia with experience in data analysis, statistical modeling, and data visualization. 
I am interested in applying quantitative methods to real-world problems in patient healthcare and healthcare consulting.

---

## What I Do

- Data analysis using R, Python, Excel, SQL
- Statistical modeling and regression
- Data visualization and dashboards
- Work with real-world datasets
